variants.headline: Business-start grant programme ends
variants.body: The grant programme {programme} for people starting a business has ended. We judge the stewardship of {target} inadequate; practical responsibility should be assessed against a demanding standard.

variants.headline: A grant scheme closes its account
variants.body: Business-starting support under {programme} has come to an end. We judge the stewardship of {target} inadequate; practical responsibility should be assessed against a demanding standard.

variants.headline: Support programme reaches its end
variants.body: The programme {programme} has ended its support for people starting a business. We judge the stewardship of {target} inadequate; practical responsibility should be assessed against a demanding standard.
